breadcrumb.label: Office of the Royal Society Holds Oath-Taking Ceremony to Be Good Civil Servants and the Strength of the Nation on the Occasion of His Majesty the King’s Birthday

paragraphs: On 22 July 2026 at 1:00 p.m., at the hall on floor
2, Office of the Royal Society, The Government Complex Commemorating His Majesty the King's 80th Birthday Anniversary, 5th December B.E. 2550, Dr. Supharoek
Phuphongsak, Secretary-General of the Royal Society, led executives,
civil servants and staff of the Office of the Royal Society in an oath-taking ceremony to be good civil servants and a strength of the nation
for 2026 on the occasion of His Majesty the King's Birthday, 28
July 2026, by unveiling the floral cone offering with incense and candles before the royal portrait of His Majesty the King and offering birthday blessings
leading the oath of allegiance, and singing the Royal Anthem and the song Sadudi Chom Racha to express loyalty
and boundless gratitude for His Majesty's grace
